name: core_Array_Mem_val
statement: ∀ {α : Type u} {as : Array α} {a : α}, as.Mem a → a ∈ as.toList

name: core_Array_erase_append
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [inst_1 : LawfulBEq α] {a : α} {xs ys : Array α}, (xs ++ ys).erase a = if a ∈ xs then xs.erase a ++ ys else xs ++ ys.erase a

name: core_Array_erase_replicate
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {n : Nat} {a b : α}, (Array.replicate n a).erase b = if (b == a) = true then Array.replicate (n - 1) a else Array.replicate n a

name: core_Array_exists_mem_empty
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (p : α → Prop), ¬∃ x x_1, p x

name: core_Array_false_of_mem_extract_findIdx
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α} {xs : Array α} {p : α → Bool}, x ∈ xs.extract 0 (Array.findIdx p xs) → p x = false

name: core_Array_filterMap_wfParam
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {xs : Array α} {f : α → Option β}, Array.filterMap f (wfParam xs) = Array.filterMap f xs.attach.unattach

name: core_Array_foldrM_fold_empty
statement: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {f : α → β → m β} {init : β} {i j : Nat} (h : j ≤ #[].size), Array.foldrM.fold f #[] i j h init = pure init

name: core_Array_foldr_filterMap'
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → Option β} {g : β → γ → γ} {xs : Array α} {init : γ} {start : Nat}, start = (Array.filterMap f xs).size → Array.foldr g init (Array.filterMap f xs) start = Array.foldr (fun x y => match f x with | some b => g b y | none => y) init xs

name: core_Array_getElem_modify_self
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : Array α} {i : Nat} (f : α → α) (h : i < (xs.modify i f).size), (xs.modify i f)[i] = f xs[i]

name: core_Array_getElem_replace_of_ne
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a b : α} {xs : Array α} {i : Nat} {h : i < xs.size}, xs[i] ≠ a → (xs.replace a b)[i] = xs[i]

name: core_Array_getLast_toList
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (xs : Array α) (h : xs.toList ≠ []), xs.toList.getLast h = xs.back ⋯

name: core_Array_idxOf_lt_size_iff
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {xs : Array α} {a : α}, Array.idxOf a xs < xs.size ↔ a ∈ xs

name: core_Array_le_min?_iff
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} [inst : Min α] [inst_1 : LE α] [Std.LawfulOrderInf α] {xs : Array α}, xs.min? = some a → ∀ {x : α}, x ≤ a ↔ ∀ (b : α), b ∈ xs → x ≤ b

name: core_Array_mem_eraseIdx_iff_getElem?
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α} {xs : Array α} {k : Nat} {h : k < xs.size}, x ∈ xs.eraseIdx k h ↔ ∃ i, i ≠ k ∧ xs[i]? = some x

name: core_Array_mem_flatten_of_mem
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xss : Array (Array α)} {xs : Array α} {a : α}, xs ∈ xss → a ∈ xs → a ∈ xss.flatten

name: core_Array_mem_zipIdx'
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α} {i : Nat} {xs : Array α} (h : (x, i) ∈ xs.zipIdx), i < xs.size ∧ x = xs[i]

name: core_Array_set_append
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs ys : Array α} {i : Nat} {x : α} (h : i < (xs ++ ys).size), (xs ++ ys).set i x h = if h' : i < xs.size then xs.set i x h' ++ ys else xs ++ ys.set (i - xs.size) x ⋯

name: core_Array_size_mergeSort
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {le : α → α → Bool} {xs : Array α}, (xs.mergeSort le).size = xs.size

name: core_Array_toListRev_iterFromIdx
statement: ∀ {β : Type w} {array : Array β} {pos : Nat}, (array.iterFromIdx pos).toListRev = (List.drop pos array.toList).reverse

name: core_Array_toList_zipWith
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → β → γ} {xs : Array α} {ys : Array β}, (Array.zipWith f xs ys).toList = List.zipWith f xs.toList ys.toList

name: core_Array_unattach_replicate
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {n : Nat} {x : { x // p x }}, (Array.replicate n x).unattach = Array.replicate n x.val

name: core_Int_Cooper_resolve_left'_congr_simp
statement: ∀ (a a_1 : Int) (e_a : a = a_1) (c c_1 : Int), c = c_1 → ∀ (d d_1 : Int), d = d_1 → ∀ (p p_1 : Int) (e_p : p = p_1) (x x_1 : Int) (e_x : x = x_1) (h₁ : p ≤ a * x), Int.Cooper.resolve_left' a c d p x h₁ = Int.Cooper.resolve_left' a_1 c_1 d_1 p_1 x_1 ⋯

name: core_Int_Internal_Linear_cmod_gt_of_pos
statement: ∀ (a : Int) {b : Int}, 0 < b → Int.Internal.Linear.cmod a b > -b

name: core_Int_Internal_Linear_cooper_left_split_ineq
statement: ∀ (ctx : Int.Internal.Linear.Context) (p₁ p₂ : Int.Internal.Linear.Poly) (k : Nat) (b : Int) (p' : Int.Internal.Linear.Poly), Int.Internal.Linear.cooper_left_split ctx p₁ p₂ k → Int.Internal.Linear.cooper_left_split_ineq_cert p₁ p₂ (↑k) b p' = true → Int.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote' ctx p' ≤ 0

name: core_Int_Internal_Linear_norm_dvd
statement: ∀ (ctx : Int.Internal.Linear.Context) (k : Int) (e : Int.Internal.Linear.Expr) (p : Int.Internal.Linear.Poly), e.norm.beq' p = true → (k ∣ Int.Internal.Linear.Expr.denote ctx e) = (k ∣ Int.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote' ctx p)

name: core_Int_add_bmod_left
statement: ∀ (a : Nat) (b : Int), (↑a + b).bmod a = b.bmod a

name: core_Int_bmod_self
statement: ∀ {a : Nat}, (↑a).bmod a = 0

name: core_Int_dvd_self_sub_of_fmod_eq
statement: ∀ {a b c : Int}, a.fmod b = c → b ∣ a - c

name: core_Int_ediv_lt_ediv_of_lt_of_neg
statement: ∀ {a b c : Int}, b < a → c ∣ a → c < 0 → a / c < b / c

name: core_Int_emod_add_mul_ediv
statement: ∀ (a b : Int), a % b + b * (a / b) = a

name: core_Int_emod_lt
statement: ∀ (a : Int) {b : Int}, b ≠ 0 → a % b < ↑b.natAbs

name: core_Int_emod_self
statement: ∀ {a : Int}, a % a = 0

name: core_Int_gcd_dvd_natAbs_left
statement: ∀ (a b : Int), a.gcd b ∣ a.natAbs

name: core_Int_gcd_mul_right
statement: ∀ (m n k : Int), (m * n).gcd (k * n) = m.gcd k * n.natAbs

name: core_Int_gcd_one
statement: ∀ {a : Int}, a.gcd 1 = 1

name: core_Int_lcm_dvd_lcm_mul_left_left
statement: ∀ (a b c : Int), a.lcm b ∣ (c * a).lcm b

name: core_Int_lcm_dvd_mul_self_right_iff_dvd_mul
statement: ∀ {k m n : Nat}, (↑n).lcm ↑k ∣ m * k ↔ n ∣ m * k

name: core_Int_lcm_one_right
statement: ∀ (a : Int), a.lcm 1 = a.natAbs

name: core_Int_lcm_zero_left
statement: ∀ (a : Int), Int.lcm 0 a = 0

name: core_Int_lt_ediv_iff_of_dvd_of_neg
statement: ∀ {a b c : Int}, c < 0 → c ∣ b → (a < b / c ↔ b < c * a)

name: core_Int_map_add_toArray_rcc'
statement: ∀ {m n k : Int}, Array.map (fun x => k + x) (m...=n).toArray = (k + m...=k + n).toArray

name: core_Int_map_add_toList_rcc'
statement: ∀ {m n k : Int}, List.map (fun x => k + x) (m...=n).toList = (k + m...=k + n).toList

name: core_Int_natAbs_fdiv_le_natAbs
statement: ∀ (a b : Int), (a.fdiv b).natAbs ≤ a.natAbs

name: core_Int_negOfNat_eq
statement: ∀ {n : Nat}, Int.negOfNat n = -Int.ofNat n

name: core_Int_negSucc_emod_ofNat
statement: ∀ {a b : Nat}, Int.negSucc a % ↑b = Int.subNatNat b (a % b).succ

name: core_Int_neg_mul_emod_right
statement: ∀ (a b : Int), -(a * b) % a = 0

name: core_Int_neg_ofNat_le_natCast
statement: ∀ (n m : Nat), -OfNat.ofNat n ≤ ↑m

name: core_Int_ofNat_fdiv
statement: ∀ (m n : Nat), ↑(m / n) = (↑m).fdiv ↑n

name: core_Int_sign_tdiv
statement: ∀ (a b : Int), (a.tdiv b).sign = if a.natAbs < b.natAbs then 0 else a.sign * b.sign

name: core_Int_tdiv_mul_cancel
statement: ∀ {a b : Int}, b ∣ a → a.tdiv b * b = a

name: core_Int_tmod_lt_of_pos
statement: ∀ (a : Int) {b : Int}, 0 < b → a.tmod b < b

name: core_Int_trailingZeros_neg
statement: ∀ (x : Int), (-x).trailingZeros = x.trailingZeros

name: core_Option_getD_guard
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Bool} {a b : α}, (Option.guard p a).getD b = if p a = true then a else b

name: core_Option_get_bind
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {x : Option α} {f : α → Option β} (h : (x.bind f).isSome = true), (x.bind f).get h = (f (x.get ⋯)).get ⋯

name: core_Option_guard_true
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, (Option.guard fun x => true) = some

name: core_Option_instLawfulIdentityOrNone
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, Std.LawfulIdentity Option.or none

name: core_Option_join_le
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LE α] {o : Option (Option α)} {o' : Option α}, o.join ≤ o' ↔ o ≤ some o'

name: core_Option_left_lt_of_merge_lt
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LT α] {f : α → α → α}, (∀ (a b c : α), f a b < c → a < c) → ∀ {o₁ o₂ o₃ : Option α}, Option.merge f o₁ o₂ < o₃ → o₁ < o₃

name: core_Option_toArray_pfilter
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {o : Option α} {p : (a : α) → o = some a → Bool}, (o.pfilter p).toArray = (Array.filter (fun x => p x.val ⋯) o.toArray.attach).unattach

name: core_Option_toList_none
statement: ∀ (α : Type u_1), none.toList = []

name: core_Option_wellFounded_lt
statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {rel : α → α → Prop}, WellFounded rel → WellFounded (Option.lt rel)
